title: Environment variables
description: The settings used by the API, web build, and Mac client.

sections.title: API configuration
paragraphs: Set these in the server environment before starting the API.
table: Primary bearer token; dev for local development
Share-signature secret; falls back to LOFT_TOKEN
API origin; defaults to local listen port
Web origin for issued links; defaults to API origin
Optional download pacing in bytes per second

sections.title: Web build
paragraphs: Vite embeds these values at build time. Rebuild when changing them. Never place a secret in a VITE_ variable.
table: true disables browser-management and public-link screens; leave unset when self-hosting

sections.title: Mac client
paragraphs: Launch the Mac app with the API origin and token in its environment.
